name: SignalMatch
description: Builder-first marketplace for CPA-based creator campaigns. Builders define conversion events, set CPA rates and budgets, and approve each conversion before payout; creators earn per verified outcome.

allowed_actions: Query the public read-only JSON APIs under /api/public/*
Use read-only MCP tools such as search_creators and campaign directory queries
Navigate using links and buttons tagged with data-agent-action
requires_human_confirmation: Submitting any sign-up or sign-in form
Funding a campaign or changing campaign budget or CPA terms
Approving a conversion or releasing a payout
Rotating API keys or any action tagged data-agent-danger / data-agent-confirm
disallowed_actions: Creating accounts, campaigns, or conversion events without the account owner's explicit instruction
Fabricating, replaying, or duplicating conversion events
Accessing authenticated /app/* pages without the user's own session and consent
Modifying pricing, payout, or payment settings
Scraping private user data or bypassing rate limits
guardrails.notes: Payment and payout actions are irreversible and must always be confirmed by a human. When in doubt, stop and ask the user.
